sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a touch of color and romance to your jewellery collection with our Aqua Blue Heart Necklace. Featuring a beautiful heart-shaped aqua blue pendant framed in gold, paired with a delicate beaded chain, this piece is effortlessly elegant and eye-catching.
The soft blue heart adds a dreamy pop of color, making it perfect for everyday styling, date nights, or gifting someone special.
- Heart-shaped aqua blue pendant
- Elegant gold-tone finish
- Delicate beaded chain
- Romantic and feminine design
- Perfect for everyday wear and gifting
